B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number like a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only converting between two fractional forms with the same value but not involving a mixed/whole number (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM/common denominator (e.g., lcm(6,9)=18)
A step scales numerators/denominators to rewrite fractions with a shared denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators (tag S03 instead)
Only converting mixed/whole numbers to fractions without needing LCM/common-denominator reasoning (tag S01 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are expressed compatibly (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately (e.g., (3−3) + (4/5−2/5))
A step recognizes identical quantities subtract to 0
exclusion_criteria: The step is primarily about creating equivalent forms (common denominators or mixed-to-improper conversion: tag S01/S02)
The step is primarily about reducing/simplifying the final fraction (tag S04)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4)
A step states the result is already in lowest terms
A step rewrites an improper fraction as a mixed number (e.g., 6/5 = 1 1/5)
exclusion_criteria: The step is the actual subtraction computation (tag S03 instead)
The step is converting inputs to compatible forms before subtracting (tag S01/S02 instead)

C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and whole numbers when needed) into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number like a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8) to enable subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Only converting between two proper fractions with different denominators (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after computation (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses an LCM or states a common denominator
A step scales numerators/denominators to rewrite fractions with the same denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and no conversion is performed (tag S03 instead)
Only converting mixed/whole numbers to fractions without addressing differing denominators (tag S01 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once quantities are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts), producing the raw fractional/whole result.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately and combines the result
exclusion_criteria: The step is primarily about finding a common denominator or converting forms (tag S01 or S02 instead)
The step is primarily about reducing/simplifying the final fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in an accepted simplest form by reducing to lowest terms and/or converting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction using a common factor (e.g., 21/12 = 7/4)
A step recognizes a fraction equals 1 or 0 (e.g., 8/8 = 1) or states the result is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number as an equivalent final form
exclusion_criteria: Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or form conversion (tag S03 instead)
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions before subtracting (tag S01 instead)

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed/improper forms
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers, improper fractions, and whole numbers written as fractions to enable computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number as an improper fraction (e.g., a b/c → (ac+b)/c).
A step rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 → 15/5).
A step simplifies a nonstandard mixed number by expressing it as a sum of an integer and a fraction (e.g., 1 4/3 = 1 + 4/3).
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion.
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after subtraction (that is S04).
Only performing the subtraction once forms are already compatible (that is S03).

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator for unlike denominators.
A step scales numerator and denominator to convert each fraction to the common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and the step proceeds directly to subtract numerators (that is S03).
Only converting mixed numbers/integers to fractions without addressing unlike denominators (that is S01).
Only simplifying the final fraction (that is S04).

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are expressed with a common denominator (or already share one), including subtracting whole and fractional parts when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b).
A step subtracts after converting to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
A step decomposes mixed numbers into whole-part and fractional-part subtraction and then computes the fractional difference.
exclusion_criteria: Only choosing/converting to a common denominator without performing the subtraction (that is S02).
Only converting mixed numbers/integers to fractions (that is S01).
Only reducing the resulting fraction to lowest terms or converting to a mixed number (that is S04).

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed fraction to lowest terms and/or express the result in an acceptable final form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
A step recognizes a fraction is already in lowest terms.
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or identifies a result as an integer/zero.
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main purpose is finding a common denominator (that is S02).
Any step whose main purpose is performing the subtraction (that is S03).
Any step whose main purpose is converting mixed numbers/integers before subtraction (that is S01).
